INSERT INTO rate_limits (bucket, hits, expires_at) VALUES ($1, 1, to_timestamp($2::double precision)) ON CONFLICT (bucket) DO UPDATE SET hits = rate_limits.hits + 1 WHERE rate_limits.hits < $3 RETURNING hits

SELECT id, user_id, revision, application_id, gap_analysis_id, title, skills, problem, solution, tasks, completion_criteria, metrics, estimated_effort, state, created_at, updated_at FROM project_blueprints WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $2
SELECT id::text AS id, status, revision::text AS revision, consumed_at::text AS consumed_at FROM approvals WHERE kind = 'CLI_EXECUTE' ORDER BY id
